verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a business back-office platform covering incorporation, compliance, registered agent, accounting, tax, mailroom and banking access, so contract handling is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions contract routing, approval workflows or e-signature. The only 'approval' reference is partner banking applications being sent for approval, which is an unrelated feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can route contracts through configurable approval workflows before signature
